_note: CHUNK-USAGE-1110 (WP11, work/CHUNK-VALUE-1110/plan.md section 6b). Per-chunk match-to-use counters in vera_vjay.chunk_use (migration 025, owner-run). Counts and UTC dates only; no question text. Best-effort: increments are queued in memory, flushed in bounded batches by a background thread, and dropped on any error; /ask is never slowed or failed. The writer also stays off until the table is detected (to_regclass probe, re-probed every probe_s), so shipping this code before the migration is inert.

demote._note: Selection-time score demotion. weight 0 = OFF (shipped). When weight > 0, a chunk with matched_count >= k_min and used_count = 0 has its admission relevance sort key multiplied by 1 / (1 + weight * max(0, ln((matched_count + 1) / (used_count + 1)) - threshold)). Rank change only: no candidate is removed, no floor is changed. Raise weight only after enough observations exist (plan 6b-3) and the offline guard and live Ask checks pass. Reversible by setting weight back to 0.
